findings.text: the fragment states 'Ten negative controls, each applied to the module and restored' and enumerates ten, but only three mutations exist or ran (logs/negative-control.log, negative-control-no-exit.log, negative-control-summary.log, negative-control-figures.log, and the three-mode apply_mutations.py in the run scratch); seven of the section's ten declared controls were never executed, so the section's done_when is unmet and the evidence artifact overstates what was measured.

this file reaches reckon.crew.promotion_evidence through reckon.cli and three of its cases pass at base faf94938 (verified: 3 passed) but fail at head (logs/head-focused.log, 3 failed, 84 passed, EXIT=1), so the change adds three failures in a test file exercising the guard and the done_when's 'add no failure against the base revision' is not met; the fixtures need an EXIT=0 record and a result-count line, which is outside this node's declared write paths and is reported under outside_scope.

_RESULT_COUNT_LINE restates the existing _RUNNER_SUMMARY at reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:1067 in the same module, and _last_pytest_summary_failures:1178 re-implements the failed-plus-errors sum that reckon/crew/standing_suite.py:197 _result_counts already derives from that same regex, so the runner-summary vocabulary now has three owners and a change to it must be made in three places.

the digest identity branch compares the arm's log_digest against sha256 hexdigest of the log text, a convention no producer in the repository writes (--gate-log-digest is operator-supplied and the manifest template names no algorithm), so an arm that cites only a digest is silently never compared and no test covers that branch.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it reports status complete, commits 4665b678 and b4b70562, both gate arms, the repro and a 309-row sweep, and its own rubric line claims ten negative controls that the recorded logs do not support.
